input.title: Button info card is not displayed when user selects greyish Command from the list on Customize Toolbar screen
input.body: ## Step to reproduce 1. Tap Setting 2. Tap Customize Toolbar 3. Scroll down to Delete Thoughts section on the Command List for easy spotting 4. Tap on any greyish Commands ## Current behavior Nothing happens. Button info card is not displayed **Video:** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4082c31c-a96b-4ab8-a3c1-b65a3831473a ## Expected behavior Button info card should be displayed accordingly to the button that is tapped / selected
